# developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Articles — Guides — Fraud Tools

> 10 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Articles — Guides under Fraud Tools. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Fraud Tools

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/overview): Braintree’s fraud tools *may not* be enabled on your account by default.
- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/basic/overview): Braintree's Basic Fraud Tools are a set of customizable rules that allow you to protect your account against carding attacks or other fraudulent activity.
- [3D Secure](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/3d-secure): 3D Secure (3DS) is an additional security layer for online credit and debit card transactions that adds an authentication step for customers making online purchases.
- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/premium/overview): While configuring [Basic Fraud Tools](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/basic/overview) is an important first step in protecting your account from…
- [AVS and CVV Rules](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/basic/avs-cvv-rules): AVS and CVV rules only apply to credit cards.
- [Risk Threshold Rules](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/basic/risk-threshold-rules): Risk threshold rules only apply to credit card and transactions.
- [Fraud Protection Lite](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/premium/fraud-protection-lite): Fraud Protection Lite (FPL) is a self-service, machine learning–based fraud solution designed for small to mid-sized merchants.
- [Fraud Protection Advanced](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/premium/fraud-protection-advanced): Fraud Protection Advanced is one of our that harnesses decades of intelligence from billions of purchases processed by PayPal and Braintree.
- [Chargeback protection tools](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/premium/chargeback-protection): The **Chargeback Protection tool** helps reduce the risk of fraudulent credit and debit card transactions in real-time.
- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/fraud-tools/premium/chargeback-protection/best-practices): Chargeback Protection (CBP) works best when paired with robust fraud prevention practices implemented at the application and transaction level—such as validating user behavior,…
